frogger.souvenir.none: the road is still busy and the burrows are still empty — the frog is waiting!
frogger.souvenir.tried: out into the traffic you went. that is the brave part.
frogger.souvenir.home: you got a frog home! the burrow is not empty any more.
frogger.souvenir.all: every burrow full, every frog home. what a crossing!
